question: Which among the following minerals is essential for the synthesis of thyroid hormones (thyroxine)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iodine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thyroxine **is a hormone produced by the **thyroid gland,** which is located in the **neck.**
 
• **Iodine** is an essential mineral required for the **synthesis of thyroxine.**
 
• Without sufficient iodine, the thyroid gland cannot produce enough thyroxine, leading to** hypothyroidism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron:**

 
 
• Iron is required for the formation of **hemoglobin in red blood cells,** which carry oxygen to the body's tissues.
 
• Iron deficiency can lead to** anemia,** which causes **fatigue, weakness, and other symptoms.**
 
 
 
• **Selenium:**
 
 
• Selenium is a trace mineral that acts as an **antioxidant **and helps to maintain the health of the **immune system**, among other functions.
 
 
 
• **Chromium:**
 
 
• Chromium is a trace mineral that helps to **regulate blood sugar levels** and may have a role in weight management.
